title: Tainan food guide: 15 classic places to eat
desc: Fifteen classic Tainan eats, grouped into beef soup and congee, noodles and rice cakes, and snacks and sweets.

items.title: A Cun Beef Soup (阿村第二代牛肉湯)
items.memo: Beef soup on Bao An Road, serving since 1968; Michelin-recognized.

items.title: A Hsing Congee (阿星鹹粥)
items.memo: Bib Gourmand milkfish belly and oyster congee; closed Mondays.

items.title: Fu Tai Table 3rd Gen (福泰飯桌 第三代)
items.memo: 80+ years old; minced pork rice and fried milkfish belly.

items.title: Yong Kee Milkfish Ball (永記虱目魚丸)
items.memo: Milkfish ball soups and minced pork rice from 6:30 am.

items.title: Kaiyuan Mackerel Thick Soup (開元紅燒土魠魚羹)
items.memo: Fried Spanish mackerel thick soup; Michelin pick with English menu.

items.title: Du Hsiao Yueh (度小月擔仔麵)
items.memo: Danzai noodles and minced pork rice from a name dating to 1895.

items.title: Small Park Danzai Noodles (小公園擔仔麵)
items.memo: Bib Gourmand dry danzai noodles; closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

items.title: Yi Wei Pin (一味品碗粿魚羹)
items.memo: Bib Gourmand; only bowl rice cake and milkfish thick soup.

items.title: Fu Sheng Hao (富盛號)
items.memo: Two items only: bowl rice cake and swordfish thick soup.

items.title: Zai Fa Hao (再發號百年肉粽)
items.memo: Century-old shop with three kinds of sticky rice dumplings.

items.title: Chikan Coffin Bread (赤崁棺材板)
items.memo: Coffin bread hidden inside Kangle Market; curry version too.

items.title: A Song Gua Bao (阿松割包)
items.memo: Gua bao with pork, pork skin or tongue, served with pork broth.

items.title: Jin De Spring Rolls (金得春捲)
items.memo: Sells only popiah, fresh spring rolls; closed Tuesdays.

items.title: Tongji Anping Douhua (同記安平豆花)
items.memo: Tofu pudding from the Anping shop; three locations in Tainan.
